title: Best Private Cooking Classes in Dubai: What to Compare
body_markdown:
Choose a cooking class by the cuisine you want to learn, how much hands-on time you expect and the setting that suits your group. A private session at home, a teaching studio and a group workshop offer different experiences.

## About this guide

This guide is published by myCHEF, a provider of private chef and catering services. It compares service formats and practical selection criteria. Individual providers should be assessed through their current proposals, relevant documentation and suitability for your occasion.

## Choose the teaching format

For a private session, ask how the chef adapts the lesson to beginners or more confident cooks. A demonstration is useful for watching techniques, while a hands-on class needs enough equipment and workspace for each participant. Confirm whether you will prepare a complete meal or focus on a particular skill.

## Plan for the group and kitchen

Share the ages, experience levels and number of participants. Check the available work surfaces, hobs and ovens, and ask which equipment the instructor brings. Family and team sessions benefit from tasks that let everyone participate without crowding the kitchen.

## Compare what the booking includes

Confirm ingredients, recipes, teaching time, equipment, the meal afterward and kitchen clear-down. Ask about dietary needs before selecting dishes. A class price should describe the group size and format, rather than leaving you to infer what each guest will be doing.

## Questions to ask before confirming

Request a written menu and scope, confirm the guest count and service hours, and check which staff, equipment and extras are included. Share dietary requirements before approving the menu. Review the payment schedule, change deadlines and cancellation terms, and identify the contact who will coordinate the booking.

## Explore the myCHEF service

If private cooking classes suits your plans, explore the service details and published options below. Share your date, Dubai location, guest count and preferences so the team can assess availability and prepare a tailored proposal. The written booking confirms the final menu, responsibilities and price.

[Explore private cooking classes](/private-cooking-classes-dubai) · [Request a proposal](/inquiry)
